extraction.Name: Ola Didier Gilbert
extraction.Refused/Protested: No. Well the patent was issued without my asking for it and I was surprised at it because my trust patent said that the land was to be held twenty five years
extraction.NOTES: Has five children; using land for cattle pasturing though does not make home on it; signed a hog mortgage only (not against land); never notified about sheriff sale; records show land was sold by sheriff of Tripp County, South Dakota on December 13, 1928 to Wewel State Bank for $1726.49; allottee states she was never notified; trust patent stated land was to be held twenty-five years; allottee signed receipt for patent; not in good health; document also references allotment 2960 for another individual on the same page
